scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix frontend && npm run lint --prefix backend
scripts.postinstall: npm install --include=dev --prefix backend && npm install --include=dev --prefix frontend
scripts.render:backend: npm install --include=dev --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix backend
scripts.render:frontend: npm install --include=dev --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix frontend
